name: Axis_Bank
_comment_use_nse: Axis's IR pages already give us exhaustive 5-year coverage (the IP page native <select> exposes 18 years, and the PR page pre-renders ~245 PRs spanning 2007-2025 in a single fetch). NSE adds noise — board-meeting notices, analyst-meet schedules, intimation letters — that don't survive the doc_types_whitelist anyway but cost cookies-warming time per run. Disable.
_comment_sources: Both pages need Playwright. IP page has a NATIVE <select> for fiscal year — the engine's js_fetcher iterates within the history window automatically (no adapter required). PR page tabs (year + month sidebar) are pure JS no-ops over a single pre-rendered DOM; engine's single-render path picks up everything, and the classifier's URL-path /YEAR/MONTH/ parser (added 2026-05-22) extracts FY from the archive URLs. See banks/Axis_Bank/notes.md for the full investigation.
